item.text:
Reconstructed all 47 verses across 13 stanzas in [mnjhi-nokri.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/2/workspaces/ef41bfa79efe479ba0ac9fa2f8b7a59d/src/data/lyrics/mnjhi-nokri.md). The lyric’s grammar and recurring forms identify it as Sindhi, so I used Sindhi script and updated the language metadata. The Roman wording is preserved in `romanLyrics`, with recitation markers removed.

The two editions match in stanza and verse counts. The spellings for “Hulmi” and “Mil Jme Wari Ja” in stanza 10 are tentative.
